annotation_scope: No expert process/attack annotation added. Short traces are flagged, not deleted.

fields.event_class: Pseudonymous event category; no attack meaning is inferred.
fields.ok: Source boolean when present; not an attack label.
fields.previous_value: Supplied previous value, not assumed to reconstruct every state transition.
fields.record_index: Ordinal in source file; gaps are not automatically packet loss.
fields.relative_seconds: Elapsed time from first parseable source timestamp within trace.
fields.signal_id: Pseudonym; equality is preserved, physical quantity and units are not supplied.
fields.trace_id: Release-local sequence group; one source-file group is not necessarily one independent physical experiment.
fields.value: Typed observed value/state token; unit/range and physical interpretation unknown.
